values.summary: Implemented #299 exact-authority archived-projection cleanup, remediated prior review findings, and closed the final receipt predecessor-chain forgery gap. Existing final receipt detection remains read-only immediately after deriving operation_root from an existing ledger and before creating operation directories, namespaces, or receipts. Final-chain validation now requires the expected receipt filenames, exact operation-created authority payload, exact namespace-created private namespace authority, and rejects unexpected receipt entries; coherent fully rehashed seq1, seq2, and extra-receipt forgeries are rejected with byte-for-byte ledger snapshots unchanged.
actual_changes: Recovered the failed r7 review assignment without recording PASS. Preserved reviewer finding exactly in audit/SRP: P1 forged final receipt could short-circuit cleanup if an attacker supplied a matching forged predecessor receipt because the final validator used the highest numeric predecessor without validating the expected cleanup receipt chain.

Changed final receipt validation to validate the exact expected cleanup receipt chain before accepting AlreadyCompleted: operation-created, namespace-created, per-node placeholder-created/captured/removed/placeholder-disposed receipts, and cleanup-complete must match expected sequence/state/previous digest chain.

Added seq1 operation-created semantic validation: payload must exactly bind current issue, cleanup operation_id, terminal issue/digest, completed recovery receipt digest, canonical archive manifest digest, and canonical archived root authority.

Changed seq2 namespace-created receipts to include private namespace owner/mount authority and validate it read-only: private_root == private-delete, mode == 0700, uid/gid match operation root, and device/mount matches operation root.
Rejected unexpected operation ledger entries and nonempty private-delete namespace contents during final-chain validation instead of ignoring extra receipt filenames or sequence entries.

Added coherent fully rehashed forgery regressions for operation-created payload drift, namespace-created payload drift, and a valid-looking unexpected 777-removed.json receipt; each rehashes the full chain and asserts the entire cleanup ledger snapshot including file bytes remains unchanged after rejection.

Mapped incomplete preexisting completed-operation ledgers with missing private namespace to CorruptRecord rather than leaking raw Io, preserving the typed corrupt-record contract and zero-mutation behavior.

Preserved prior remediations: production crate API wiring through csdlc_v2, completed recovery receipt plus canonical archive manifest authority before cleanup mutation, temp receipt previous_receipt_digest and placeholder_identity validation, archive-local ledger rejection before descendant creation, and early forged-final zero-mutation handling.

Preserved ownership boundaries: source/test edits are limited to csdlc-v2/src/projection_cleanup.rs and csdlc-v2/tests/archived_projection_cleanup.rs for this remediation; did not edit projection_recovery.rs, store.rs, or gate5.rs.
